candidates.change_summary: Change the returned value from true to false so that successful completion yields false instead of true.
Return the success value of the last low-level call instead of returning a constant true, making the overall return reflect call outcome.
Return logical AND of all individual call success values instead of constant true; if any call fails (without reverting), overall return becomes false.
Return false immediately after the first successful call, changing observable return though calls may have been made.
Change the called function selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,uint256) altering which external function is invoked on caddress.
Change the call to use delegatecall instead of call, causing the invoked code to execute in this contract's context and potentially alter observable state.
Remove the require(_s) after the external call so failures of the external call don't revert, changing post-call observable state.
Invert the require that checks _tos.length to require it equals 0, causing the function to revert for non-empty lists and thus change observed transfer behavior.
